intro.text: A planetary system with three inner rocky worlds and ten outer gas giants, separated by an asteroid belt.

description.text: The outer planets are named Jes, Nan, Chach, Vev, Palah, Shash, Betab, Kak, Tanat and Ishi, in order away from the sun.
Braize has an unusual metallic core that attracts Investiture and souls.

items.text: Roshar once had a fourth moon. It fell before Honor reached the system, leaving fragments beneath the future Shattered Plains.

The formation of Retribution slowed time around Roshar relative to the wider cosmere, disrupting trade and communication. Thaidakar estimated that a Rosharan decade could correspond to seventy or eighty years elsewhere.
